messages.subject: P-value to consider for a qtl
parts:
HI , 

I am using BXD genetic reference population for lipidomics analysis from livers of the mice. 
Would it be correct if I consider all QTLs below P-value <0.63 or <0.40 rather than be very restrictive and take only the p-values <0.05 ?
Thanks
